narrative_draft: Low-elevation sparse meadow / shrubland, Populus tremuloides-dominated
narrative_curated: Dense big sagebrush (34%) with young aspen at meadow-forest edges; 2026-only.

narrative_draft: Low-elevation sparse meadow / shrubland, Opuntia polyacantha-dominated
narrative_curated: Driest, earliest-melt steppe with bitterbrush, rabbitbrush, plains pricklypear and soapweed yucca; 2026-only lowest-elevation class.

narrative_draft: Low-elevation sparse meadow / shrubland, Tetradymia canescens-dominated
narrative_curated: Low-elevation mixed shrub-steppe: sagebrush, bitterbrush, wax currant and horsebrush over a third bare ground.

narrative_draft: Low-elevation sparse meadow / shrubland, Ericameria nauseosa-dominated
narrative_curated: Earliest snow-free sagebrush steppe with rubber and yellow rabbitbrush, bitterbrush and Indian ricegrass; mostly 2025/2026 low-elevation plots.
Sparsely vegetated (56% bare) eroding slopes with dwarf rabbitbrush, arrowleaf balsamroot and Phlox multiflora.
Tall-shrub thickets of chokecherry (34%) and snowberry (24%) with serviceberry and shrubby cinquefoil on mesic montane toe-slopes.
Montane sagebrush-Thurber fescue matrix with kinnikinnick and Erigeron speciosus; early snow-free, moderate bare ground.

narrative_draft: Mid-elevation montane dry meadow, Aquilegia coerulea-dominated
narrative_curated: Big sagebrush (22%) over dense Thurber fescue (18%) with abundant cured litter; largely 2026 low-elevation plots.

Heterogeneous montane dry-mesic matrix of scattered low shrubs (Symphoricarpos, Amelanchier, Artemisia tridentata) over mixed forbs with sulphur buckwheat and mule's-ears; the largest 2023-campaign class, spectrally coherent but compositionally broad.
Dry montane park with pendent-pod crazyweed, prairie smoke and heavy cured litter (NPV ~25%).

narrative_draft: Mid-elevation montane dry meadow, Carex sp.-dominated
narrative_curated: Dry montane park with silver sagebrush (Artemisia cana), sedges and sulphur buckwheat over heavy litter (NPV ~30%).
Sagebrush park with very heavy cured litter (NPV 41%) and low forb cover (pussytoes, woolly cinquefoil); mostly 2026 plots.
Mule's-ears-dominated (22%) montane swale meadow with curlyhead goldenweed and wet-indicator inclusions (elephant's-head, marsh-marigold).
notes: Best NatureServe analog 'Wyethia amplexicaulis Meadow' (G3) is not recorded for CO by NatureServe - flag for curation.

narrative_curated: Montane dry-mesic meadow of Wyethia amplexicaulis, Lupinus argenteus, Thurber fescue and Lathyrus over ~30% exposed soil/litter.
Mesic montane meadow with scattered snowberry and shrubby cinquefoil over Erigeron speciosus, Potentilla pulcherrima and dandelion; strongly 2023-sampled.
Half-bare (46%) rocky montane barren with sulphur buckwheat, false goldenaster and scattered sagebrush; 2025-only.
Monotypic Osmorhiza occidentalis (~86% cover) in mesic montane-subalpine meadow openings; monotypic override class.
notes: No NatureServe community bears this species; nearest CO home is the Heracleum maximum - Veratrum viride Wet Meadow Alliance (mesic tall-forb group) - flag for curation.

narrative_curated: Monotypic Veratrum tenuipetalum (~85% cover) wet-mesic meadow patches; monotypic override class.
Forb-rich subalpine turf (unnamed forbs ~31%) with meadow pussytoes, pale agoseris and dwarf bilberry; 2025/2026-only.
Monotypic Ligusticum porteri (~85% cover) patches within subalpine tall-forb meadows; monotypic override class.
Subalpine wet sedge meadow (Carex aquatilis, C. saxatilis) with timothy and tufted hairgrass suggesting historically irrigated/hay-influenced sites.
Large generalist subalpine mesic meadow: osha, dwarf bilberry, Delphinium, Helianthella and showy goldeneye in mixed forb turf; the biggest class in the scheme (n=120).
notes: Borderline splittable (gate recall ~0.28); first candidate for ancillary-covariate subdivision.

narrative_curated: Mesic subalpine meadow of Lathyrus lanszwertii, Potentilla pulcherrima and sulphur paintbrush.
notes: needs_ancillary: gate recall 0.25 - mappability requires wetness/phenology covariates.

narrative_curated: Osha-dominated (33%) tall-forb facies with Engelmann aster, Senecio serra and Delphinium; compositionally distinct from S09.a but spectrally confusable.
notes: needs_ancillary: final CV recall 0.00 - retain for ecological fidelity only.

narrative_curated: Classic subalpine tall-forb community: corn-lily with Mertensia ciliata, cow parsnip, Delphinium barbeyi and osha on wet-mesic slopes and swales.
Near-pure Corydalis caseana (96% cover) on subalpine seeps and streamside terraces; 2018-only monotypic override class.
Monotypic stands of Caltha leptosepala (~88% cover) on late-melt wet snowbed basins and seep margins; assigned by the >=70% monotypic-cover rule rather than the classifier.
Vaccinium cespitosum heath (32% cover) with false goldenaster and lupine on late-melt benches.

narrative_draft: Upper subalpine rocky shrub-steppe, Bromopsis ciliata-dominated
narrative_curated: Sparse subalpine forb cover on rocky ground (36% bare): hairy false goldenaster, silvery lupine and Arnica.
Upper-subalpine tufted hairgrass-forb meadow with osha, Arnica mollis and Senecio crassulus; late snow-free.

narrative_draft: Late-melt alpine / subalpine sparse meadow / shrubland, Chamaenerion angustifolium-dominated
narrative_curated: Subalpine meadow with smooth brome and fireweed signalling disturbance history, over bilberry and Arnica.

narrative_draft: Late-melt alpine / subalpine meadow, Bistorta bistortoides-dominated
narrative_curated: Late-melt alpine wet turf of Calamagrostis stricta, tufted hairgrass, arctic rushes and American bistort.

narrative_draft: Late-melt alpine / subalpine meadow, Tolmachevia integrifolia-dominated
narrative_curated: Late-melt (DOY ~170) alpine wet forb turf: Rhodiola (Tolmachevia) integrifolia, marsh-marigold, Senecio triangularis and queen's crown; 2018-alpine sampled.
